oncall-bot: INCIDENT 1979012345 created by ashwin — Serving runtime: CUDA OOMs reported on gpu-pool-prod-7. Auto-escalation to oncall SRE. Priority: P1 :rotating_light:

ashwin: seeing repeated `CUDA out of memory` on node gpu-7-03 even though headroom shows ~500MB free. Heap/kv-cache logs attached below. Errors started ~10:12 UTC, traffic impact on a small subset of requests (500rps -> 50% failures).

maria: ping. Can you paste the runtime logs? is this a single model or all models on the node?

ashwin: single model variant: gptx-13b-q8f. Logs:```2026-02-18 10:12:34 ERROR runtime: allocation failed: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory
2026-02-18 10:12:34 WARN allocator: reserve_blocks total=6 free=2 reserved=4
2026-02-18 10:12:34 INFO kv-cache: holding 1.3GiB in prefixes, headroom=512MiB
2026-02-18 10:12:34 ERROR runtime: paging triggered, fallback started
```

oncall-bot: Paging oncall alice -> leo (15m).

leo: I'm on it. Ashwin, are the OOMs correlated with specific request sizes/seq lengths?

ashwin: yes — long-context requests 8k+ tokens spike the allocations. Also noticed allocator fragmentation: reserve_blocks are not contiguous; smaller free chunks but total free + reserved > needed but allocation fails.

maria: that suggests headroom accounting is global but allocator can't satisfy contiguous block. We saw similar before where KV prefix cache pinned many small blocks. Can we drop prefixes for that model?

ashwin: can try. Proposed mitigation: 1) trigger runtime prefix eviction for gptx-13b-q8f on gpu-7-03 2) temporarily route traffic for that model to a different pool 3) if still flapping, restart runtime container to defragment.

infra-sre: note — restarting container will cause a short cold-start for existing sessions. If we can avoid restart by evicting cache that's preferable.

maria: command to evict prefixes (non-blocking):```# evict prefixes for model on node
curl -X POST "https://ops-api.internal/v1/nodes/gpu-7-03/evict" -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" -d '{"model":"gptx-13b-q8f","type":"prefixes","limit_mb":1600}'```

ashwin: running eviction now.

ashwin: eviction returned: `\{"evicted_mb":1536, "op":"prefix-evict", "node":"gpu-7-03"}`

ashwin: watching logs... ```2026-02-18 10:15:10 INFO kv-cache: evicted 1536MiB prefixes
2026-02-18 10:15:11 INFO allocator: free blocks consolidated: largest_free=2.1GiB
2026-02-18 10:15:11 INFO runtime: allocation succeeded after eviction
```

leo: good sign. Any client errors still?

ashwin: error rate dropped to baseline within ~30s. A couple of in-flight sessions hit timeouts and were retried. No long-term customer impact detected yet.

product-ops: which customers were impacted? we need to notify if SLA affected.

ashwin: small set of enterprise accounts using long-context. I'll DM list to product-ops. No charge disputes yet.

maria: follow-up: we should adjust reserve_blocks sizing for this model on gpu-7 class. Current reserve policy is too tight for heavy long-context workload. Suggest increasing contiguous reserve or enabling on-demand compaction. Also file a follow-up RFC for a KV-cache admission control threshold per-node.

infra-sre: agree. Also propose a short-term runtime config change roll: decrease per-prefix retention from 10m -> 2m on hot nodes. That should prevent rebuilds but free memory faster.

leo: leaving oncall to ashwin for remediation and follow-ups. I'll update the incident ticket and set SLO impact to minimal (brief 30–60s spike for subset).

oncall-bot: handover: leo -> ashwin at 10:30 UTC.

ashwin: adding runbook steps and linking postmortem ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4621. Action items: [ ] update reserve config, [ ] implement per-node KV admission, [ ] add metric for largest_free_block size and fragmentation ratio, [ ] run compaction experiment in staging.

maria: quick trick for future: you can use `allocator.inspect()` in the debug shell to get free-face map. Example:```python
>>> from runtime.debug import allocator
>>> allocator.inspect()
{"total_free": 2048, "largest_free": 2100, "fragmentation": 0.42}
```

ashwin: closing incident channel — node stable and no further OOMs after eviction + temporary routing. Will keep postmortem and mitigations on INF-4621. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: INCIDENT 1979012345 status -> resolved by ashwin at 10:50 UTC

leo: thanks team. Follow-up owners assigned in ticket.

product-ops: noted — communications will go out if customers ask.

infra-sre: add this to the weekly runtime frag report.

maria: nice quick mitigation. Learned: headroom != contiguous block. We should make that explicit in ops docs. :eyes:
